e.title: Modern Insurance Pricing Course (burning-cost)
e.summary: 免费 12 模块课程（burning-cost）：现代保险定价 + Python/Databricks——GLM/GBM/SHAP/conformal/贝叶斯可信度/约束优化
e.summary_en: Free 12-module course (burning-cost): modern insurance pricing with Python/Databricks — GLM/GBM/SHAP/conformal/Bayesian credibility/constrained optimisation
e.summary_hk: 免費 12 模塊課程（burning-cost）：現代保險定價 + Python/Databricks——GLM/GBM/SHAP/conformal/貝葉斯可信度/約束優化
e.body: Modern Insurance Pricing with Python and Databricks（burning-cost 官方课程）是免费 12 模块实操课程：从 Databricks 基础到生产级费率复核管道——GLM、GBM、SHAP 相对数、conformal 预测、贝叶斯可信度、约束费率优化、因果需求建模、空间领土费率。对 RIAA：定价方向的系统化自学路径——把 burning-cost 家族散落的工具（[[insurance-distributional-glm]]、[[insurance-gam]]、[[insurance-conformal]]、[[bayesian-pricing]]、[[insurance-optimise]]）串成完整课程；面向 Emblem/Radar 从业者的迁移路线；与 [[insurance-pricing-course]] 配套（两者互补，本课程更深更工程化）；免费 + 开源是最大优势。
e.body_en: Modern Insurance Pricing with Python and Databricks (the burning-cost official course) is a free 12-module hands-on course: from Databricks basics to a production-grade rate review pipeline — GLMs, GBMs, SHAP relativities, conformal prediction, Bayesian credibility, constrained rate optimisation, causal demand modelling and spatial territory rating. For RIAA: a systematic self-study path for pricing — weaving the family's scattered tools ([[insurance-distributional-glm]], [[insurance-gam]], [[insurance-conformal]], [[bayesian-pricing]], [[insurance-optimise]]) into a complete course; a migration route for Emblem/Radar practitioners; complements [[insurance-pricing-course]] (this one is deeper and more engineering-oriented); free and open-source is the biggest win.
e.body_hk: Modern Insurance Pricing with Python and Databricks（burning-cost 官方課程）是免費 12 模塊實操課程：從 Databricks 基礎到生產級費率複核管道——GLM、GBM、SHAP 相對數、conformal 預測、貝葉斯可信度、約束費率優化、因果需求建模、空間領土費率。對 RIAA：定價方向的系統化自學路徑——把 burning-cost 家族散落的工具（[[insurance-distributional-glm]]、[[insurance-gam]]、[[insurance-conformal]]、[[bayesian-pricing]]、[[insurance-optimise]]）串成完整課程；面向 Emblem/Radar 從業者的遷移路線；與 [[insurance-pricing-course]] 配套（兩者互補，本課程更深更工程化）；免費 + 開源是最大優勢。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：官方课程 README（12 模块/免费/开源），未实测
